rows.law: Silence-biased intervention: an inject-vs-silent gate must abstain under ambiguity because a bad reminder is worse than silence.
rows.claim: The gate runs a deterministic SILENT-first order (relevance floor, cooldown, any key token still visible in last k steps) before INJECT on full decay, and its self-test requires ZERO false-positive injections while still catching real decay; every inject AND silent decision is registered as one JSONL row so false positives are auditable after the fact.
rows.quote: a bad reminder is worse than silence
rows.steal: Decision order as a pure function over the memory 4-tuple plus a register of both inject and silent decisions; the closing lesson for any fleet gate is register both actions, not only the loud one.
rows.falsifier: A run where an in-cooldown, below-floor, or still-visible-token memory fires INJECT, or any false-positive injection passing the self-test, breaks the law.

rows.law: Unmeasured fan-out widths snap DOWN to the lower tier's budget; widening is owned by the value gate, never by the tier.
rows.claim: effort_for_width() maps T1 fact_finding (1 lane, 3-10 calls), T2 comparison (2-4 lanes, 10-15 per lane), T3 complex (>10 lanes, gate-governed); widths 5-10, between the measured bands, fall to T2 per-lane budget rather than up to uncapped T3, and any fan-out wider than 1 lane must clear a 15x value-per-token bar.
rows.quote: so they fall DOWN to T2's per-lane budget rather than up to uncapped T3.
rows.steal: Anthropic multi-agent effort bands as first-class lane parameters plus the 15x token premium admission gate; the anti-overinvestment snap is directly portable to any dispatch layer.
rows.falsifier: A width in 5-10 resolving to a T3 budget, or a multi-lane fan-out admitted without clearing the 15x value-per-token bar.

rows.law: Ephemeral capability is default-OFF and dies at the turn boundary; a leased tool must never shadow a static one.
rows.claim: With ADK_ENABLE_SKILL_LIFECYCLE unset, load() refuses and the tool registry is never mutated; with it on, a skill loads for exactly one seat-turn, end_turn() unloads everything loaded at or before the current turn, load() sweeps stale entries so a seat that never calls end_turn still cannot accumulate, and unload is idempotent with a receipt on every mutation.
rows.quote: Default OFF: with the gate unset, load() refuses
rows.steal: Google ADK check-time env gate pattern fused with ZCode's skill/tool unit; one-turn lease semantics via turn counters is a reusable overlay for any lease-bound tool (tools.register_ephemeral).
rows.falsifier: A skill name still dispatching in turn T+1 after loading in T with the gate on, or any registry mutation observable while the gate is unset.

rows.law: Strip write capability at the schema before any model call; a spawned lane never sees tool definitions it cannot use.
rows.claim: Classification is by name: write-class tools (estate write_file, harness Write/Edit family, shared-state writers pheromone_drop and blackboard_post) always stripped; dual_use (run_shell, bash, run_python) kept unless strict=True; unknown names default to read so a lane never loses capability silently, and the receipt lists every kept name for audit.
rows.steal: Runner-side --read-only strip wired orchestrator spawn_task to main.py to agent_cli, implementing single-writer doctrine: extra agents contribute intelligence while writes stay single-threaded (MICKEY-17 owed chore, Cognition April 2026 reversal).
rows.falsifier: A child cmd missing --read-only after a write-classified grant, a write tool visible in a stripped child's schema, or a kept unknown tool absent from the receipt.
